summary: The registrant, Lead Real Estate Co., Ltd, filed a Form 6-K announcing a cash dividend for its fiscal year ending June 30, 2026. The dividend rate is to be determined by the board in August 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the annual general meeting in September 2026. The dividend is expected to be payable on or about September 30, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine event with no M&A or special-situation characteristics.
